sharing.title: Who can see your report, and who has looked
sharing.standfirst: You choose what your partner and your counsellor can see of your own screening report. Every change is written to a log you can check.

partial.sharing: The sharing ledger could not be loaded:
partial.audit: The audit trail could not be loaded:

intro.heading: How sharing works here
intro.partner: Each person controls what their partner sees of their own report. You decide about yours; your partner decides about theirs. You can grant or revoke a share at any time.
intro.state: The state is a statutory recipient of screening data (<ltr>Decree-Law 49/2023, Art. 26(2)</ltr>). Nothing on this page hides your data from the state, and this product never claims to. These choices are about your partner and your counsellor.
intro.notToKnow: You also have the right not to know your own results (<ltr>Art. 9(2)</ltr>). That right is separate from the sharing choices on this page.

ledger.heading: Sharing ledger
ledger.caption: Every sharing choice recorded for this couple. You can revoke only the rows that are about you; the other person's rows are read-only.
ledger.refreshError: The ledger could not be refreshed. The list below may be out of date.

empty.title: Nothing is shared yet
empty.body: No sharing choices are recorded yet. You decide who can see your own report, what they see and for how long, and you can revoke it at any time.

couple_result_only.label: Couple result only
couple_result_only.description: They see whether a shared result was found for the two of you, in the same plain words you see. They do not see your individual findings.

gene_names_only.label: Result and gene names
gene_names_only.description: They see the couple result and the names of the genes involved in your own findings. They do not see variant detail.

full_variant_detail.label: Result and full variant detail
full_variant_detail.description: They see the couple result and the full variant detail from your own report. This is the widest choice.

revoke.title: Stop sharing with {recipient}?
revoke.body: From now on, "{scope}" will no longer be shared from your report. This is recorded in the audit trail.
revoke.note: Anything already seen cannot be taken back. The state's statutory access is not affected by this choice.

grant.heading: Share your report
grant.intro: Choose one person and one level of detail. You can set an end date, and you can revoke the share later.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.hint: Choose the reason from the list the service accepts. It is shown in the ledger and the audit trail.

expiry.label: Ends on (optional)
expiry.hint: Leave empty to share until you revoke.

purposes.partner_disclosure: Share my findings with my partner, to the level I choose
purposes.couple_counselling: Share my findings with the counsellor or clinician for our counselling
purposes.service_referral: Share my findings with a referral service I choose
purposes.service_interest_follow_up: Contact me about services I chose to hear about
purposes.research_secondary_use: Use my data for an extra purpose (needs fresh written consent)

audit.intro: Each event in this log stores a hash of the event before it, so a change or removal anywhere breaks the chain. You can check it yourself below. This log is held in memory in this demo.
audit.caption: Events recorded for this couple.
audit.okOwn: Events about your couple that were checked: {count}.
audit.okDetail: Events in the chain: {length}. Head hash:
audit.brokenDetail: The first event that does not match is number {index}.
audit.brokenNoIndex: The API reported a mismatch but did not say where.
audit.scopeNote: This is a tamper-evidence check on this demo ledger, not an external or legal proof.
audit.empty: No events are recorded for this couple yet. Granting or revoking a share adds the first one.
audit.refreshError: The audit trail could not be refreshed. The list below may be out of date.
audit.title: What has happened to your information
audit.earlierCaption: Earlier events recorded for this couple.
audit.earlierCapped: Showing the newest {listed} of the earlier events. {unlisted} older events are in the log but not listed here. Verify chain checks all of them.

matrix.title: You decide what {name} sees. The law fixes the rest.
matrix.intro: Only the first column is yours to change. Every change writes a row to the audit log below. Screening itself is mandatory and not consent-based (Art. 4(2)(a), 15); sharing your own findings is.
matrix.introEmpty: Nothing is shared yet. Use Share in the first column.
matrix.caption: Who can see which part of your report
matrix.care: Sees what the {policy} rule allows, for your care
matrix.footnote: Employers and insurers may not require or use results: Federal Decree-Law 49/2023, Art. 19 to 21. A request from either is refused and logged. Rishta Safe never claims to hide data from the health authorities.
matrix.partnerMissing: Your partner's details could not be loaded, so the sharing switches are not shown. The ledger below still works.
